map.输入工作压力、温度、介质与运动速度等工况，推荐密封材料（NBR/FKM/PU）与: Enter duty conditions such as working pressure, temperature, medium and motion speed, and the tool recommends seal material (NBR/FKM/PU) and type (O-ring / Yx ring / Glyd ring and so on), and estimates seal service life from overall duty severity, supporting hydraulic system maintenance selection.
map.寿命估算 L = L₀ × f压力 × f速度 × f温度 × f介质（L₀ 基: Life estimate L = L0 × f_pressure × f_speed × f_temperature × f_medium (base L0 = 10,000 h); reduction factors: P above 21 MPa ×0.6, P above 10 MPa ×0.8; v above 1 m/s ×0.6, v above 0.5 m/s ×0.8; T above 120 °C ×0.5, T above 80 °C ×0.7; water/emulsion medium ×0.8; L at least 8000 good, at least 5000 fair
map.密封件寿命以基准寿命（约 10000 h）为基础，按工况严苛度逐项折减：压力越高: Seal life starts from a base life (about 10,000 h) and is reduced item by item by how severe the duty is: higher pressure, higher speed, higher temperature and poorer medium lubricity all reduce it more, and stacking the items gives the estimated life under multi-factor coupling. Material and type follow the duty - FKM for high temperature or phosphate ester media, PU preferred for water/emulsions, and for ultra-high pressure reciprocating service above 40 MPa a tandem combined seal with a guide ring against eccentric wear.
